title: Early access to my game
author: landonloverLover
selftext:
Hello, I'm looking for some input on my game, Top Down Mage. It's a top down roguelike shooter where the main goal is to reach the highest wave possible and create the craziest build you can.

It's not a very serious game. A lot of the upgrade names and mechanics are inspired by inside jokes with my friends, random ideas, or stuff from other media, so don't be surprised if some or a lot of things don't exactly make sense.

All the ideas and game mechanics come from me, while Codex handles the programming. I've mostly been making this for fun and adding whatever ideas I come up with.

The game is completely free, with no payments or downloads required.

I'm mainly looking for people's opinions on the gameplay, difficulty, upgrades, and whether it's actually fun to play. Any feedback is appreciated!

[https://jj-z.itch.io/top-down-mage-eav3](https://jj-z.itch.io/top-down-mage-eav3)
